name: Kodo Bone
summary: Kodo bones from Desolace’s Kodo Graveyard are valuable to Bibbly F'utzbuckle. He sees many uses for them, from furniture and instruments to blasting powder.

sections.title: A Goblin’s Trade
sections.body: Bibbly F'utzbuckle at Kormek's Hut seeks kodo bones from the graveyard south of his home. He says customers make furniture, musical instruments, and blasting powder from them. A caravan carries his bones to Shadowprey Village, and Bibbly hopes the trade will make him rich.

faq.answer: Bibbly F'utzbuckle at Kormek's Hut wants kodo bones from the Kodo Graveyard.

faq.q: What are kodo bones used for?
faq.answer: Bibbly says his customers make furniture, musical instruments, and blasting powder from kodo bones.

faq.q: Where does the caravan take the bones?
faq.answer: Bibbly says a caravan sells his kodo bones at Shadowprey Village.
